Players Committee card image of [[A New Secret Base (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Deploy on table. Once per turn, may use 2 Force to deploy a battleground system from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Your non-unique starfighters apply their deployment modifiers at any location. Once per turn, if you just Force drained at a battleground system, may draw top card of Reserve Deck. (Immune to Alter.)”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/anewsecretbase.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
